items.s: Thank you! You are very ___.
items.tip: -ful means 'full of' and makes a describing word: help → helpful.
items.say: Thank you! You are very helpful.
items.ask: Thank you! You are very blank.

items.s: The garden is full of ___ flowers.
items.tip: colour + -ful = colourful (full of colours). colorful is the American spelling.
items.say: The garden is full of colourful flowers.
items.ask: The garden is full of blank flowers.

items.s: Be ___ when you cross the road.
items.tip: care + -ful = careful (taking care).
items.say: Be careful when you cross the road.
items.ask: Be blank when you cross the road.

items.s: It's ___ today, so take your sunglasses.
items.tip: Weather words often add -y. sun has one vowel + one consonant, so double the n: sunny.
items.say: It's sunny today, so take your sunglasses.
items.ask: It's blank today, so take your sunglasses.

items.s: It was a ___ day, so we played games inside.
items.tip: Weather words often add -y: rain → rainy.
items.say: It was a rainy day, so we played games inside.
items.ask: It was a blank day, so we played games inside.

items.s: The princess wore a ___ dress.
items.tip: beauty + -ful: the y changes to i: beautiful.
items.say: The princess wore a beautiful dress.
items.ask: The princess wore a blank dress.

items.s: The puppy is very ___ and loves games.
items.tip: play + -ful = playful (full of fun).
items.say: The puppy is very playful and loves games.
items.ask: The puppy is very blank and loves games.

items.s: The classroom was very ___ at lunchtime.
items.tip: noise + -y: drop the e first: noisy.
items.say: The classroom was very noisy at lunchtime.
items.ask: The classroom was very blank at lunchtime.

items.s: The turtle walks very ___.
items.tip: To say HOW someone does something, add -ly: slow → slowly.
items.say: The turtle walks very slowly.
items.ask: The turtle walks very blank.

items.s: Please speak ___ in the library.
items.tip: How do you speak? quiet + -ly = quietly.
items.say: Please speak quietly in the library.
items.ask: Please speak blank in the library.

items.s: The children played ___ in the garden.
items.tip: Consonant + y: change y to i, then add -ly: happy → happily.
items.say: The children played happily in the garden.
items.ask: The children played blank in the garden.

items.s: Run ___! The bus is coming!
items.tip: How should you run? quick + -ly = quickly.
items.say: Run quickly! The bus is coming!
items.ask: Run blank! The bus is coming!

items.s: Hold the baby bird ___.
items.tip: careful + -ly = carefully (so it has two l's).
items.say: Hold the baby bird carefully.
items.ask: Hold the baby bird blank.

items.s: She answered all the questions ___.
items.tip: Consonant + y: change y to i, then add -ly: easy → easily.
items.say: She answered all the questions easily.
items.ask: She answered all the questions blank.

items.s: The lion roared ___.
items.tip: How did it roar? loud + -ly = loudly.
items.say: The lion roared loudly.
items.ask: The lion roared blank.

items.s: Our team played ___ and won the cup.
items.tip: good is special: the -ly word for good is well.
items.say: Our team played well and won the cup.
items.ask: Our team played blank and won the cup.

items.s: Today is ___ than yesterday.
items.tip: hot has one vowel + one consonant, so double the t before -er: hotter.
items.say: Today is hotter than yesterday.
items.ask: Today is blank than yesterday.

items.s: My dog is the ___ dog in the world!
items.tip: the + -est. Change y to i first: happy → the happiest.
items.say: My dog is the happiest dog in the world!
items.ask: My dog is the blank dog in the world!

items.s: This is the ___ film I have ever seen. I laughed a lot!
items.tip: the … I have ever seen = number one, so -est: funny → the funniest.
items.say: This is the funniest film I have ever seen. I laughed a lot!
items.ask: This is the blank film I have ever seen. I laughed a lot!

items.s: My new school bag is ___ than my old one.
items.tip: big: one vowel + one consonant, so double the g: bigger than.
items.say: My new school bag is bigger than my old one.
items.ask: My new school bag is blank than my old one.

items.s: Mia is my ___ friend.
items.tip: good is special: good → better → best.
items.say: Mia is my best friend.
items.ask: Mia is my blank friend.

items.s: My handwriting is ___ than my brother's.
items.tip: bad is special: bad → worse → worst. Comparing two people, so worse than.
items.say: My handwriting is worse than my brother's.
items.ask: My handwriting is blank than my brother's.

items.s: An elephant is ___ than a hippo.
items.tip: large ends in e, so just add -r: larger than.
items.say: An elephant is larger than a hippo.
items.ask: An elephant is blank than a hippo.

items.s: That was the ___ test of the year.
items.tip: the … of the year = number one, so -est; change y to i: easiest.
items.say: That was the easiest test of the year.
items.ask: That was the blank test of the year.
